subject: mathematics_1b
question_text: Find the value of a if the area of the triangle formed by the lines x=0, y=0, 3x+4y=a is 6 sq.units.

recall_prompt: Say how you would solve this — name the area formula for a line with the two axes.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Read off the coefficients
steps.margin_note: First mark. The triangle a line makes with BOTH axes has a formula of its own — Δ = c²/(2|ab|) — so the only setting-up needed is to compare with ax + by + c = 0.
steps.memory_tip: The triangle a line makes with BOTH axes has its own formula, Δ = c²/(2|ab|) — just compare coefficients.
lines: On comparing with ax + by + c = 0, we get
Area of the triangle is  Δ = c²/(2|ab|)

recall.must_convey: That the equation is compared with ax + by + c = 0 and the area formula Δ = c²/(2|ab|) is written.
accept: compare with a x plus b y plus c equals zero and use delta equals c squared over two mod a b
the area formula for a line with both axes
read off a b and c then apply the formula
a b c teesukoni area formula rayali
area is c squared by two mod a b
heard_as: a x plus b y plus c

steps.why: This formula already accounts for the two intercepts and the right angle at the origin, so no intercepts need finding separately.
common_mistakes: Getting the sign of c wrong when the equation is rearranged.
Dropping the modulus and producing a negative area.

steps.label: Solve for a
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Set the formula equal to the given area and solve — the modulus means the answer comes in a ± pair.
steps.memory_tip: Set the formula equal to the given area. The modulus means the answer comes as a ± pair.

lines.text: ⇒ a = ±12,  hence the value of a is ±12

recall.must_convey: That setting the area equal to the given value gives a = ±12,  hence the value of a is ±12.
accept: set the area equal to six and solve for a
a squared over twenty four equals six
solve to get a equals plus or minus twelve
area ni equal chesi solve cheyyali
a is plus or minus twelve

steps.why: a appears squared in the formula, so both a positive and a negative value give the same area — both are genuine answers.
common_mistakes: Reporting only the positive value of a.
Forgetting to square c before dividing.

insider_note: Use Δ = c²/(2|ab|) with the line written as 3x + 4y − a = 0, so c = −a and c² = a². Since a² = 144 both signs are answers, a = ±12, and giving only 12 loses the second mark.
